_metadata.description: YouTube videos that will never be fetched again, keyed by video id with the reason they were retired. scripts/download-audio.mjs skips these and scripts/check-pipeline-health.mjs excludes them from the unfetched-audio guard, so a video that is genuinely gone from YouTube does not red every run forever.
_metadata.usage: Add an entry ONLY when the video is confirmed unavailable at its source (deleted, made private, or never recorded). A fetch that fails for any other reason is a bug to fix, not an entry here.
